Method A real scanned mesh, not a procedural solid — and the same studio it would have been shot in. The room is built geometry, panels and bounce cards prefiltered once through PMREM, because a polished surface reflects shapes and a gradient gives it nothing to find. The import shipped one roughness value for the whole object; the crown/body split is read back out of its own baked atlas, so the waxy shell takes a clearcoat and the fibrous blades transmit light instead of both being the same plastic.
